svg.title: FinAware — Flow: AI Wording and Its Safety Net
svg.text: FinAware — Flow: AI Wording and Its Safety Net

How every feature that uses OpenAI asks it (lib/ai/model.ts). FinAware always works out the answer itself first; the model may only reword it. Any doubt at any step, and the calculated answer is used instead.
built and tested; no page yet
its own request, same pause and fallback
FinAware works out the answer first
Every figure, and a complete calculated answer — the rehab tips, the advisor from keywords, the
summary, the letter — ready to fall back on
Model from OPENAI_MODEL (gpt-4.1-mini by default); the answer must be strict JSON against
Receives the feature's instructions and the figures FinAware worked out
— never a password or an ID document
Every rand amount in it is one
Use the model's wording — the figures are FinAware's either way
The figures guardrail, figuresAllowed(): finds every "R 1 234,56"-style amount
in the text and compares it with the figures FinAware gave the model;
rounding to the nearest rand is allowed. Used by the Case Summary and the
letter drafts, which write about money. The dashboard tips have no such
check: their Zod schema is checked, and the actions the model words carry
The page shows FinAware's own answer, worked out in step 1
Nobody waits on the model, and nothing breaks because of it
logged every time, so a key that does nothing is easy to spot
so no page waits for the same refusal
every feature starts the same way
FinAware · Flow: AI Wording and Its Safety Net · drawn from the code · updated 29 September 2026
